Narrative time is dusk and overrides any reference-image lighting; the relationship axis connects <Subject 1> and <Subject 2>, camera stays south of this axis, <Subject 1> moves from screen-left outside the door toward screen-right <Subject 2> inside the courtyard, <Subject 2> stays screen-right facing left toward screen-left <Subject 1>; no axis crossing or screen reversal. At most one 0.8–1.5s static shot if narratively justified; all other shots use one motivated primary camera move. Key light is warm 3000K dusk side-light at low angle, with courtyard and dirt-road bounce fill. Speaker-locked camera during dialogue. His face suddenly lights up with joy—his vacant eyes brighten. He ignores <Subject 4> at his feet, releases the telescopic handle, and walks quickly toward the courtyard, steps stumbling like a child seeing his parents. Captured with a full-frame-equivalent 35mm lens at f/2.8, shallow depth of field, focus on <Subject 1>. The camera leads backward in front of <Subject 1> as he walks quickly toward the courtyard, keeping him at screen-left and <Subject 2> at screen-right, decelerating as he shouts. Motivated cinematic lighting: warm 3000K dusk side-key at low angle shapes <Subject 1>'s face; dirt road and locust tree provide warm bounce fill; long shadows; denim jacket texture and skin detail PBR-clear; shadow detail preserved. His square face with thick eyebrows frowns, expression guarded and annoyed. Old locust tree and wooden door in the background, warm dusk light. Captured with a full-frame-equivalent 35mm lens at f/4, moderate depth of field, focus on <Subject 1> and <Subject 2>. The camera makes a quick truck from screen-left toward screen-right following the hug-and-block action, decelerating as <Subject 2>'s hand makes contact.
